nodes.name: Schedule Trigger
nodes.notes: Runs every Monday at 9am. Manual execution also supported for testing.

nodes.name: Calculate Date Windows
nodes.notes:
Calculates UTC windows:
- Last Week: Previous Mon 00:00 to Sun 23:59:59
- Next 14 Days: Today 00:00 to +14 days 23:59:59

Monday logic: If today is Monday, use the week that just ended.

nodes.name: Filter & Categorize
nodes.notes:
Categorizes tickets into 7 buckets:
1. FE Deployed Last Week
2. BE Deployed Last Week
3. FE Expected Next 14 Days
4. BE Expected Next 14 Days
5. Team Focus Items (by epic)
6. Risks/Blocks
7. Uncategorized

Classification: component field > key prefix > Uncategorized

nodes.name: Generate Week ID
nodes.notes: Generates ISO week identifier (e.g., 2026-W03) for file naming and report headers.

nodes.name: Format Confluence
nodes.notes:
Generates Markdown for Confluence:
- Deployed Last Week (FE/BE)
- Expected Next 14 Days (FE/BE)
- Team Focus Items (by epic)
- Risks & Blockers
- Other Items (if any)

Handles [None] for empty categories.

nodes.name: Format Slide
nodes.notes:
Generates two-column text layout for Google Slides:
- Left: Deployed items
- Right: Upcoming items
- Bottom: Focus items and risks

Limits items per section for readability.

nodes.name: Is First Monday?
nodes.notes:
Checks if today is the first Monday of the month.
Used for monthly rollover logic (future enhancement).
Currently both branches continue to file output.
